assessment.reason: The projection of 9.08, with a median of 9, clears 7.5 by a reasonable margin. The +130 price and an expected normal role give the case enough to merit human review, without validating the model's number.
assessment.model_case: The 27.3 projected minutes drive a 9.08 rebounds-plus-assists mean. The main weakness is minutes volatility: a smaller role would erode the cushion. Teammate absences are not modeled and could cut either way.
assessment.price_case: This is a single main line at +130, with break-even near 0.435. The market estimate of 0.455 comes from only one other book, so the large model/market gap needs scrutiny. The blended 0.473 still exceeds break-even.
assessment.context_case: The listings show several absences in this game, including Detroit's Duren and Joe and two Washington game-time decisions. Jenkins is not shown in the excerpt, which neither confirms nor denies his status. No sourced report addresses his role.

qualitative_review.countercase: The market may expect fewer minutes than 27.3 if Jenkins' role is fluid. A blowout could also cut his playing time. This bet shares a game and exposure group with the Reed under, so the two are correlated, not independent.
